answers.notes: Identity certificate is available under the 2019 TG Act; RBD 1969 historically limited birth-record changes to error/fraud. Statement I overstates the bar.
India is the fourth docking nation after US, Russia and China. Statement 2 is therefore not correct.
Among the given options, J.C. Bose is the figure recent commentary links to a Gandhi-like satyagraha in science; the epithet is not universal.
HCES is MoSPI/NSSO, not Finance. Rural food-share remains higher than urban.
MuleHunter.ai and RBI sandbox are finance-sector tools. NSAI and DPDP are broader national frameworks, not specifically ethical AI in finance.
Chilla refers to a forty-day period, not “stay indoors”. Pheran Day/21 Dec and Chillai-Khurd/Bachha are established.
Baykar (Turkey).
Kaas Plateau is in Maharashtra, not UP. Vembanad/Ashtamudi–Kerala–NGT penalty and Yaya Tso–Ladakh BHS are right. 3-column text was reconstructed.
Arts 16, 19 and 29 are citizen-only; Art. 28 is not.
Rarest-of-rare is settled (Bachan Singh). RG Kar did not newly confine death penalty only to “no reformation” cases.
NA/SA peaks are swapped. Elbrus/Elbruz (Europe) and Kosciuszko (Australia) are the usual pairs.
Risk factors are metabolic (high lipids/BP); treatment is not primarily fat-removal surgery.
Both statements are true; 1946 UN specialized-agency status does not explain tripartism.
Item 5 is not a standard impact of Paris withdrawal.
2024–25 Ratnagiri work reported colossal Buddha heads, a monolithic elephant, votive stupas/inscriptions, and Bhaumakara-period mahavihara remains.
2017 amendments bar inheritance/transfer by heirs.
ONOE requires amending duration/session provisions including 83, 85, 172 and 174 (among others). Closest option.
DIA allows duty-free import up to (not above) ¼ carat; 10% value addition is required. Prompt asks which is not correct.
CSS (not central sector) and MoWCD (not HRD). Only the sex-ratio objective is clearly true.
TB is not a typical food-borne pathogen.
Campylobacter is classic; listing norovirus as a primary cause is weak.
Indian antivenom is equine, not goat-derived.
Open-access central rules and the residuary-powers holding are the parts most clearly supported; state-rule wording is less certain from the stem alone.
IUCN Vulnerable; tropical. Kemp’s ridley is the smallest; diet is not primarily plants.
Statement 1 swaps the usual 90% quake / 75% volcano figures. 2 and 3 hold.
Semi-Dirac: massless in one direction. Majorana (not Dirac) fermions are their own antiparticles.
WEF report, not IMF. Armed conflict was the top 2025 short-term risk.
Only Aleutian–North Pacific is right. Mariana is western Pacific; Tonga is South Pacific.
Scramjets are air-breathing. DRDO 120s ground test is documented.
Indore and Udaipur received Wetland City Accreditation.
Physical-presence KYC is not required; V-CIP/digital KYC exists.
Rare term; water-clock is the best fit among options but the word is not a standard textbook lemma.
Ramsar uses 20,000 birds not 30,000. Criteria 2, 6 and 8 match items 2–4.
Martial law is undefined; never formally declared in independent India. Art. 34 is real.
NavIC uses GSO/GEO mix; NVS-02 was not a simple “direct GEO” insertion.
WHO Class II (moderately hazardous), no reliable antidote. Use continues in India and the US.
Preamble, 19 and 21. Art. 31 repealed; Art. 15 is equality not liberty.
Native to Sumatra; bloom interval is not a rigid 20 years.
Baaz / Northern Goshawk.
Nano urea is foliar, not a soil drench. Prompt asks which is not correct.
LE rose to ~70 not 75. Other achievements are right.
Pralay is indigenous quasi-ballistic; it is not India’s longest SSM and is conventional.
Whip is a British convention, not a constitutional/statutory “choice” invented in India. All three statements fail.
Origin is Sikkim (Pauhunri/Tso Lhamo), not Kailash. Teesta-III is in Sikkim.
Bharat Ratna is higher; public nominations exist; committee is not headed by the President.
India signed/ratified in 2016. NDCs are nationally determined, not identical common targets.
Pairs were flattened in extraction. Only Bharati’s pairing is clearly right; Savarkar/Lobo attributions are swapped.
DGFT eCoO 2.0.
All four are on India’s critical-minerals list.
2015 MMDR auction-plus-PL-cum-ML model; “all leases” has narrow exceptions.
Japan-scale 2027 electricity is a general AI projection, not DeepSeek-specific.
Mitra Shakti is India–Sri Lanka. Indonesia is not India’s 2nd-largest trade partner. Both are in G20.
Coverage is not 100% and project-cost cover is not 100%; Udyam eligibility is real. Prompt: not correct.
Giddha is Punjab, not Gujarat. Other three pairs hold.
Phase 1 is not primarily the Asian–African link.
HAT is parasitic, not bacterial.
e-Shram is Labour, not MSME.
Fusion weapons are thermonuclear, not “atomic” (fission) bombs.
Wage, employment, hours and under-qualification are standard OSI ingredients; migration and automation are not part of the usual public methodology.
Indian lakes are largely eutrophic, not oligotrophic.
India signed in 1949; ratification was 1959, so “signed and ratified in 1949” overreaches.
GDP share and workforce figures are rounded but in the right band.
Controlled cultivation exists because NDPS otherwise prohibits cannabis. II explains I.
Recent official coastline length increased with methodology; it did not “reduce”.
Fentanyl is synthetic.
Squid are molluscs, not arthropods.
Kenya does not border DRC. The other five do.
Rules also reach waste generators beyond “companies only”.
State governments notify BHS, not the Centre. Guneri is a recent Gujarat BHS.
Tax cuts do not by themselves reduce the fiscal deficit.
CRIS developed SwaRail; food ordering is in the super-app scope, so 2 is not correct.
Manipur does not border Bangladesh.
UK still leads in Ramsar count. Jharkhand/Sikkim first sites and Tamil Nadu’s lead are 2024 facts.

Extensions are not strictly one-time; there is no lifetime cap on holding H-1Bs. Indians ~70% is right.

ELS is premium fine cotton, not coarse, and not grown in all cotton states.
Sagarmala is port-led development; the 95%/70% trade split is reversed (volume vs value).
FD excludes borrowings from receipts; FD and inflation are not inversely related.
MCA, not Commerce.
Orans–Rajasthan; Devara Kadu–Karnataka; Sarpa Kavu–Kerala only.
Also food-borne, not only direct contact.

Tribunals are an Assam mechanism, not JK/Arunachal.
AKDN restoration and Padma honour are well attested; “2015” is the usual citation.
Installed FGD share has been well below “around 20%”.
Vijay Durg / Maratha naval heritage is the stated reason for Indianising the name.
Stryker cannot be Chinook-lifted at combat weight.
Melt lowers albedo; it does not increase ocean reflectivity.
Parole is largely state-executive practice, not spelled out in the 1894 Act.
Budget 2025 listed these as Viksit Bharat priorities.

PM-KISAN is ₹6,000, not ₹10,000.
Lifecycle GHG of nuclear is typically below coal and comparable to, not clearly above, wind/solar depending on study.

RIDF is NABARD, not a Railways fund.
NAMASTE is Central Sector, not CSS. Prompt: not correct.
Potash does not harden water.
NCSK is presently a non-statutory extended body; it does not report to the President as a commission under Art. 338-style design.

SC 2023: re-passed bill must be assented. Reservation under 201 is not of every bill.
Late La Niña, GHGs, aerosol decline and a weak La Niña are the usual 2025 explanations.

ASHAs are incentive-based, not salaried. WHO 2022 award is true. Guideline age band is 25–45, not 25–40. Only statement 2 holds.
Forest/woodland deer, not desert.

Lower imports support the rupee; US rate hikes and trade wars can depreciate INR.
MHW definition is percentile-based; they are not summer-only; most are not “natural”.
Kandariya–Chandela and Rani-ki-Vav–Chaulukya/Chalukya hold. Chausath Yogini as Kachchhapaghata is the doubtful WH pairing. Table was wrapped in the PDF.
Range is thousands of nautical miles, not 400; the ship has anti-surface weapons too.
HKU1 is a common-cold coronavirus, not a COVID-like pandemic threat.
Removal is by President after parliamentary address, not a simple presidential dismissal.
Only Shahi Litchi–Bihar is right.
Paramhansa Sabha vs Prarthana Samaj association is the shaky claim in standard biographies.
Raisina is ORF with MEA, not MHA.
Whether the 2025 temple is truly the first dedicated shrine is not independently verified here.
India’s 24th rank is attested. Statement II (support reliably yields practice) is the generalisation the 2025 index itself undermines via the support–practice gap.
All five listed uses appear in audible-enclave explainers.
Lake is artificial (Arnoraja); Baradari is Shah Jahan. Seasonal drying is the only possibly true claim.
Laterite/well-drained soils; Karnataka is the top producer.

Rill → gully → ravine/canyon → badland.
